Container.Name: stash-sense
Container.Overview: AI-powered performer identification and library curation for Stash. Provides a REST API for identifying performers in images and scenes using FaceNet512 and ArcFace embeddings against a database of 100k+ performers from StashDB and other stash-box instances. Mount your media library (read-only unless you enable features that write files, such as subtitles) and set MEDIA_PATH_MAP so the sidecar can find Stash's files. To keep CPU-heavy jobs off some cores, add --cpuset-cpus=2-7 (your core list) to Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Port for the Stash Sense API

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Face recognition database files (Voyager indices, performers.db, JSON metadata)

Config.Name: InsightFace Cache
Config.Description: InsightFace model cache (RetinaFace detector, downloaded on first run)

Config.Name: Media Library
Config.Description: Your media library, the same share Stash reads. Leave Access Mode Read Only unless you enable a feature that writes files (subtitles); those features refuse to run on a read-only mount.

Config.Name: MEDIA_PATH_MAP
Config.Description: How Stash's file paths map to this container: stash_path=container_path, comma-separated for several libraries. Example: Stash sees /data/Studio/a.mp4, this container sees /media/Studio/a.mp4 -> /data=/media

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the sidecar runs as; files it creates get this owner (unRAID: 99 = nobody). 0 runs as root.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the sidecar runs as (unRAID: 100 = users)

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for files the sidecar writes

Config.Name: STASH_URL
Config.Description: URL of your Stash instance (e.g., http://192.168.1.100:9999)

Config.Name: STASH_API_KEY
Config.Description: Stash API key (JWT token from Stash Settings > Security)

Config.Name: DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Container path for data files (should match Data Directory target)

Config.Name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
Config.Description: Force unbuffered Python output for Docker logs
